findings.claim: Level7 distillation: top-10 methods from Lane A/B/C ledgers, filtered relevance x recency x actionability >=30/45; goal framed as 18-language W6/W7 plan (not handwriting).
findings.numbers: 984 Lane A, 659 Lane B, 436 Lane C records; 47 unique 5/5/5 methods; date locked 2026-09-29 04:23 IST

findings.claim: Sarvam Vision 2.1: 3B sovereign VLM, SFT->RLVR; Indic bench 87.39; competitors trail 3-6 pts. Treated as benchmark target not routable pipeline; weights cannot be shipped, only recipe learned.

Chitrapathak-2 (Krutrim): fine-tunes Nanonets-OCR2-3B (Qwen2.5-VL) for Indic; Telugu char ANLS 6.69 vs 11.00 for Chitrapathak-1; 89.8% exact match on 9 Indian govt doc types; ~1.03 s/doc vLLM; 3-6x faster than LLaVA-from-scratch. Evidence for 'fine-tune OCR VLM, don't build from scratch'; covers Odia (weak cell 80.01).
findings.numbers: 6.69 vs 11.00 ANLS; 89.8%; 1.03 s/doc; 3-6x; Odia weak cell 80.01

findings.claim: W6 Stage 2 decision: TrOCR-from-scratch DROP; Qwen2.5-VL-3B / GLM-OCR-0.9B fine-tune KEEP. PPT Spec Stage 2 'TrOCR from scratch' declared REFUTED.

PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 (0.9B, Apache-2.0): CPT 16.8M + SFT 7.3M + RL; OmniDocBench v1.6 96.33. Ablation CPT +0.69, SFT +0.63, RL only +0.08 (94.93->96.33). Locked W6 law: do NOT start with RL; order CPT->SFT->RL.

olmOCR-2: RLVR with binary unit-test rewards (element presence + read-order), 1 ep SFT then 1 ep GRPO; chrF++ 40.5 on Devanagari scans => English-first ceiling for Indic. Verdict: SURVIVES only for Stage 3b schema-validity head; DIES as direct Indic engine.

ScriptMoE: PP-OCRv5 + MoE router on script ID lifts F1 65.71 -> 80.89 (+15). Per-script routing already validated by probe22 (surya wins 9/12 cells of >=50-lang). Per-script QLoRA adapters cost-benefit UNKNOWN.

Surya 2 (650M single VLM: OCR+layout+order+tables): 91-lang internal 87.2 (38 langs >=90), olmOCR-bench 83.3; licence modified OpenRAIL-M (free research/personal/<$5M startups). Probe22: surya overall CER 0.3849, best non-API engine. Locked as primary wrap-only Engine #1.
OldScan subscore for surya = 42.8; OldScan weak cell cited as 55.3 elsewhere; restoration lane R4 = highest-leverage OldScan attack.
Surya latency ceiling: 4-9 s/page English but 178 s on a Hindi (Devanagari) page; Ol Chiki NOT supported by surya (sat honest-empty, A1-044). Licence check needed before Vinay demo.

Bodhan Indic OCR (33M layout + 0.8B Qwen3.5 block OCR, ~2 GB open weights): Santali 68.30 vs Sarvam 53.91 (Bodhan beats Sarvam on Santali); reference competitor for sat/ks (Nastaliq/Ol Chiki) weak cells; whether it beats surya elsewhere UNKNOWN.

Devanagari stress test: Qwen3-VL-8B gets 75.2 CER on real exam scans (matra/halant/conjunct error taxonomy). Maps to 8 Devanagari langs hi/mr/sa/ne/mai/kok/brx/doi; W6 fine-tune needs akshara-boundary auxiliary loss. Devanagari = 8/17 Indic langs.
MinerU2.5-Pro data-centric region mining corroborates PaddleOCR-VL region-aware training; concrete OldScan attack UNKNOWN.

DocRes (CVPR 2024) restoration pre-pass for R4 OldScan. Otsu = cheap baseline; DocRes-head pilot n<=8 next. Adoption bar: median dCER <= -0.03 vs Otsu, 95% bootstrap CI, >=2/3 frozen engines. DIBCO is Latin/Greek only (no transfer).

Level7 DIES/WATCH list: LLaVA-NeXT-from-scratch DIES; IndicTrans2/Airavata/MuRIL etc. not OCR tier; DeepSeek-OCR-3B/Chandra-8B/LightOnOCR-1B/Nanonets-OCR2-3B no Indic results (base only); Mistral OCR 3 (79.1 OmniDocBench) DIES (English-first); HunyuanOCR WATCH (licence risk); Krutrim-2-12B / cloud APIs wrong tier.

Locked W6 recipe (5 methods): Sarvam harness-with-VLM pattern -> Chitrapathak-2 fine-tune -> PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 region-aware sequencing -> olmOCR-2 schema-validity RL -> DocRes pre-pass. Wrap-only baseline: Surya 2 + per-script routing + restoration. Conditional: Bodhan (sat/ks), QLoRA per-script adapters (GLM-OCR 0.9B primary candidate). Paid APIs beyond 'Sarvam 54-cap' DIE.

Protocol-1 rooted-claim law: every claim row has status PRIMARY/MEASURED/DERIVED/CONTRADICTION/UNKNOWN/REJECTED/DEAD, pointer, quote<=40 words; seed ledger treated as hypotheses (REJECTED until verified); UNKNOWN is a successful output; contradictions never smoothed.

Protocol-1 EVAL lane: leakage threat model (patch/test_patch in prompts), transfer obituaries for public leaderboard numbers, Wilson 95% interval, McNemar exact paired test, pre-declared test family/no peeking, report abstention coverage separately, timeout as own failure class, base-model contamination check.

findings.claim: Honest verdict: Level 2 seal proves coverage not max potential; GT is PDF text layer (born-digital bias), L1 gold is T2-heavy distilled_vlm (circularity), data is book-heavy, not handwriting/form/stress benchmark. Evidence standard: TRUE only if disk file, 4-page gate, or marked ASSUMPTION.

Benchmark validity attack list: consensus needs >=6 of 7 family-deduped votes (shared training corpora risk), 92 hallucination events (verify_v2), 31 GT-empty pages unproven, 15 manifest_tag_suspects, kn_002-kn_013 Telugu-dominant (12% of kn), kn_035/kn_074 duplicate render, 167/400 mixed_book_page, power at strata ~40, LOOP detector 0.6 8-gram, Myers edit distance truncates >950 chars, gt_thin <200 chars null CER.

Pre-register 3 falsification conditions for Level 2 before results (A20); require bootstrap CIs on per-engine median CER (1000 reps, C7); regression alarm 2% never calibrated (C10); CER lowercases and WER on whitespace is wrong for Dravidian - propose akshara error rate (AKER) via grapheme clusters, ~30 lines (C1,C2).

Human spot-check protocol missing (10 pages, 2 passes, adjudication, CER-of-the-eye); until it exists every 'verified' claim is partial; second annotator needed. Also find what metric BHASHINI scores (C18) before Sep 16; need intake adapter for their eval set in <1 day (D15).

Zero handwriting in the 400-page benchmark (L1 had ~2 handwritten-span labels), yet deck promises handwritten exam scripts; biggest data-pitch gap; proposed plan: IIIT-HW crops as a parallel mini-bench.

Benchmark is clean textbook regime; hard pages (low contrast, skew, bleed-through, old prints) may be <5% so degradation robustness untested; native DPI of scanned PDFs unrecorded (200 DPI render may upscale 100-DPI scans); 300-DPI probe 0/10 pages and 31 empty pages unresolved.

Engine max-potential headroom never A/B'd: doctr PARSeq vs CRNN backend, rapidocr PP-OCRv5 server rec, tessdata_best + PSM grid, paddle server det (replaced by mobile under timeout), surya guided layout off (SURYA_GUIDED_LAYOUT=false grammar-400 fix), indicphotoocr identifier_lang auto vs te; each needs 4-page gate or DECISIONS.log waiver.

Ensemble idea: where >=3 independent families agree, agreement text may be cleaner than any single engine (free pseudo-GT); region/confidence harvesting (boxes, per-box confidence) not stored in packs; some engines emit ASCII digits (accuracy bug for native digits); NFD vs NFC check via raw text field.
